title: European Motorcars — claimed by thegentlemen
description: DE · Transportation · european-motorcars.com European Motorcars is a multi-brand premium European car dealership founded in 1972 in Dayton, Ohio, with 54 years of experience selling and servicing Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Audi, Porsche, Land Rover, Jaguar, Volvo and MINI. With 50 to 100 employees across two locations on Miamisburg-Centerville Road and Dorothy Lane in Kettering, it offers new and certified pre-owned vehicles,
